Name: Spider-Man: Homecoming
Review:
Rewatching Tom’s spiderman films til Brand New Day pt. 1

I honestly don’t get the hate with mcu spiderman or it’s just a twitter thingy (worse community you could ever be in ngl).  The vulture so far is a top 3 most memorable villain in all live action spiderman films for me. The chemistry between Tom and Jacob in this film was immaculate. I love the ‘cringiness’ and corniness of the film, it truly shows you what high-school feels like. The last act was amazing, love love the death and rebirth narrative (the rubble scene 🤌🏻) . I still stand to this day that Tom Holland is the best live action Spiderman/Peter Parker we’ve seen in the big screen.
